diagnosis.summary: The nightly run d2ba48cc (partition 2026-10-01) failed in transform because the mart dim_customers refers to c.country_iso, a column that doesn't exist. dim_customers is the only model that differs from the deployed version: its `c.country` line was changed to `c.country_iso`. Upstream delivered the same data as before, so the proposed fix is to revert dim_customers to the deployed version and rerun.

root_cause.explanation: An undeployed edit to dim_customers changed c.country to c.country_iso. stg_customers, raw.customers and the landing file only have the column `country`, so dbt fails with a Binder Error. Ingest succeeded, and the 2026-10-01 landing files match the contract and the previous day.

evidence.claim: The transform step failed because dbt build hit 1 error: dim_customers raised a Binder Error for the missing column country_iso.
dim_customers is the only changed model. Its diff replaces c.country with c.country_iso, and stg_customers and raw.customers have no country_iso column.
The landing customers file for 2026-10-01 matches the contract and the 2026-09-30 file, and the other tables match their contracts. So upstream didn't change anything.
The runbook says to revert the model that changed when a model errors after a deploy.

alternatives_considered: Upstream renamed country to country_iso (fix with apply_column_mapping): ruled out because the landing headers are unchanged and match the contract.
A staging model was edited: ruled out because stg_customers is unchanged and dim_customers is the only changed model.

Escalate to analytics_engineering as an intentional logic change: not chosen because the edit points to a column that exists nowhere, so it can't run as written. Restoring the deployed version is the safe step, and a planned country_iso change can be resubmitted together with the upstream columns it needs.
Transient failure (rerun_only): ruled out because the error is a deterministic binder error.

proposal.rationale: The only changed dbt model, dim_customers, replaced c.country with c.country_iso. No column called country_iso exists in stg_customers, raw.customers or the landing file, so the build fails with a Binder Error. The upstream data is unchanged and matches the contract. The runbook says to revert the model that changed.

applied: reverted models/marts/dim_customers.sql to the deployed version
